source: Built for this suite from records checked against Crossref and DataCite on 2026-10-02; errors planted by hand. Invented DOIs checked unregistered at doi.org the same day. On 2026-10-03, every item whose paper also appears in a tune list or in the reference parser's test cases was replaced with a paper of the same planted type, its record checked against Crossref and DataCite, its closed_real status in OpenAlex and its invented DOI at doi.org.
